Introduction to CompPsych

Addiction is a chronic mental health disease that can impact anyone who misuses drugs or alcohol. Researching current trends related to substance use helps mental health professionals and advocates learn where we can make the most difference. As an example, recent studies show that individuals between the ages of 18 to 25 were more likely to struggle with a substance use disorder than any other age group. This knowledge can be useful in prevention, education, and treatment efforts.

What is CompPsych Insurance?

CompPsych is the largest employee assistance program (EAP) in the world. CompPsych serves over 600,000 organizations which break down to over 130 million individuals living in the United States. In addition to the United States, CompPsych provides services in over 190 different countries.

If you are searching for a San Francisco CompPsych detox program, we invite you to call (866) 525-3026 to speak with a Marina Harbor Detox representative. Our staff only provides detoxification services which allow us to focus all our efforts on your comfort and detox. Does CompPsych Insurance Cover Addiction Treatment?

CompPsych does provide behavioral healthcare coverage for its members. This includes the treatment of trauma, attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety, depression, and substance use disorders. This also means that CompPsych can provide coverage for individuals who are living with a substance use disorder and another mental health concern, often referred to as a dual diagnosis.
CompPsych works primarily with in-network providers. If you would like to get treatment from an out-of-network provider, you may not be eligible for healthcare coverage from CompPsych.

The most useful tool that you have when looking for a treatment provider is CompPsych. A CompPsych representative can talk to you about your different options and provide you with a list of providers who are considered in-network. Additionally, they can give you a better understanding of what your financial responsibility would be based on the specifics of your healthcare plan.
A common concern that individuals have when they are looking into addiction treatment options is the cost. Addiction treatment, especially inpatient programs, can be expensive.

Does CompPsych Insurance Cover Drug Detox Services?

CompPsych can provide you with healthcare coverage for detoxification programs. CompPsych does have a different order of events than other healthcare providers when it comes to being admitted into an addiction treatment program. As an example, CompPsych may require that you participate in counseling sessions with one of their counselors to determine which level of care would be appropriate for your needs. Additionally, CompPsych often requires that you obtain a pre-authorization before you begin your treatment. Failing to do so can result in receiving no coverage from CompPsych.

It is important to understand that the coverage you have can vary from other members who have CompPsych. Your coverage will depend on factors including where you live, if your chosen provider is in-network or out-of-network, your insurance plan, and the length of time that you would require for proper treatment. This means that you may notice variations in your financial responsibility for various providers and levels of care.

The best resource at your disposal regarding addiction treatment would be a CompPsych representative or your EAP representative. Both of these individuals can help you navigate the process of finding a treatment provider, and following the necessary steps to receive coverage from CompPsych.

Marina Harbor Detox Accepts CompPsych Insurance

Marina Harbor Detox is a San Francisco drug detox center with a private, and luxurious facility. Our 6-person facility has private rooms, baths, and showers for our patients. Since we focus on detoxification services, our staff is able to provide you with the individualized care that you need. Stopping the use of drugs and alcohol can cause a shock to your system that can cause discomfort, and pain, and have the potential to cause life-threatening situations. Our staff will provide you with the support, compassion, and kindness that you deserve during this difficult time.

At Marina Harbor Detox, you will experience a holistic treatment program. This means that our staff will meet with you to determine your physical health needs, emotional needs, mental health needs, and spiritual health needs. This knowledge will be incorporated into your treatment, and help guide the development of your aftercare plan. When you are feeling well, you will be encouraged to part-take in daily nature walks in our beautiful location. Our chef-prepared meals are organic and include nutrients that promote wellness.

Deciding to come to a detoxification program can be a difficult choice, even for those who have experienced rock bottom. Making the phone call to say that you need help takes strength, and even more so the day you walk through our doors. Some of us at Marina Harbor Detox have walked a similar path, and are walking examples that recovery is possible. Call (866)525-3026 to speak with a representative today!
